'''A.S. San Giovanni''' is a [[San Marino|Sanmarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[San Giovanni sotto le Penne]], a civil parish of [[Borgo Maggiore]]. The club was founded in [[1948 in association football|1948]]. San Giovanni currently plays in [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colors are [[white]], [[red]] and [[black]].
It is the only Sammarinese side not to win any top tier [[Silverware (sport)|silverware]], as they were [[Serie A2 (football)|Serie A2]] champions in the 1994–95 season, when there was a promotion/relegation pyramid of two tiers."}}
